sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:51

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:51:1
items.html: And the lower arouses the upper, and the upper returns to bestow to the lower, degree after degree. Meaning, as was said above, in the passage beginning “must,” how ZON, through their ascent with the Yesod of AA to AVI, causes a warming there with its MAN, whereby AVI too raise MAN to the GAR of AA, and the GAR of AA further upward to the GAR of SAG of AK; and then the bestowal of the MAD begins, that AB bestows the MAD to SAG of AK, and from there to Atik, and from there to AA, and from there to AVI, and from them to ZON. Study it there well.
